TRAFFIC ADVISORY:  

The Department of Public Works and Highways will undertake restoration and reblocking works from May 22 until May 25 in the following areas:  

1. E. Rodriguez Jr. Avenue, from end of approach of Ortigas Flyover (NB) to corner Green Meadows Avenue, Quezon City 
2. C-5 Road, from fronting UP Town Center to the corner of C.P. Garcia Avenue, Quezon City 
3. Quezon Avenue, from corner BIR to fronting Lung Center, Quezon City  

The activities will be done during nighttime only from 11:00 PM to 5:00 AM. Motorists are advised to take alternate routes.   

COURTESY: MMDA  

Visit https://t.co/KqDTBMbTQD for updates.

𝐑𝐎𝐔𝐓𝐄 𝐀𝐃𝐕𝐈𝐒𝐎𝐑𝐘: Dimasalang Bridge Rehabilitation Phase II (Northbound)

Narito ang mga alternatibong ruta na inilatag ng Manila Traffic and Parking Bureau upang magsilbing gabay sa mga motorista at maiwasan ang matinding pagsisikip ng daloy ng trapiko kaugnay ng rehabilitasyon at major repair ng Dimasalang Bridge Phase II (Northbound).

Ipatutupad ang rehabilitasyon simula Mayo 23, 2026 hanggang ikalawang linggo ng Oktubre 2026.

Pinapayuhan ang publiko na planuhin ang kanilang biyahe, gumamit ng mga alternatibong ruta, at maglaan ng karagdagang oras sa paglalakbay habang isinasagawa ang proyekto. | via @ManilaPIO
